COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
13.06.2024 WPSS No. 889 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Nikhil Bhatt, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Atul Bahuguna, learned Brief Holder for 
the State.
3. Mr. Sharang Dhulia, learned counsel for the 
respondent no. 2/UKSSSC.
4. Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for the 
respondent no. 3/Uttarakhand Public Service 
Commission. 
5. Vide order dated 04.06.2024 passed by this 
Court, counsel for the respondent/Commission was 
directed to seek instructions in the matter. 
6. Today, Mr. Sharang Dhulia, learned counsel for 
the UKSSSC handed over an undated written 
instructions and submits that since the recruitment 
process was initiated for Group C posts by one and 
the same advertisement for various departments of 
the State in view of the letter dated 20.11.2017, it is 
mandated that no waiting list is to be issued in such 
eventuality. 
7. In view of the written instructions, which is 
taken on record, petitioner failed to make out any 
case for interim relief. 
8. Respondents may file counter affidavit within 
six weeks. Rejoinder affidavit may file within two 
weeks thereafter. 
9. List this matter on 06.09.2024.
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 13.06.2024
Akash
